name: Cornell University
description: Follow Cornell University, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Cornell rape case provokes questions about ketamine use on campus
changes.summary: The prescription drug ketamine was referenced in the ongoing Cornell University rape case. CBS News' Anna Schecter has more.

changes.title: How Cornell Punished Each of the 7 Men Accused of Sexual Assault
changes.summary: Summaries obtained by The New York Times offer a detailed look at the discipline meted out to the men accused of sexually assaulting a fellow student at Cornell University.

changes.title: How the Cornell case is affecting women who have experienced sexual assault
changes.summary: The rape allegations that have emerged from a Cornell University frat house are leading many women to remember their own experiences — and call for a wider reckoning over sexual violence. (Image credit: Olivia Petter).

changes.title: Cornell University to take ‘serious look’ at fraternities after rape allegations
changes.summary: Ivy League school’s president promises action after woman alleged she was drugged ⁠and raped by fraternity members Cornell University will examine the role of fraternities and sororities on campus after an outcry over the school’s handling ⁠of a student’s rape allegations, the Ivy League school’s president has said. changes.title: Jane Doe's attorney accuses Cornell of "cover-up" of alleged rape
changes.summary: Lilia Luciano spoke to the attorney for Jane Doe, who says that campus police at Cornell University failed to properly investigate after she was allegedly raped at a fraternity house in 2024.

changes.title: DA did not review statements and other evidence collected in alleged rape of Cornell student
changes.summary: Cornell University police spoke to witnesses and received tips about an alleged gang rape at a frat house, but the district attorney did not review the information before deciding not to bring charges.
